title: Adaptive Conditional Residual Sampling for Spectral Risk Optimisation under Decision-Dependent Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2603.12507v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider minimising a spectral risk objective, the expected cost plus a weighted conditional value-at-risk, when the distribution of the uncertain parameters depends on the decision and can only be sampled through a stochastic simulator under a fixed budget of draws. We propose adaptive conditional residual sampling (ACRS). It takes one simulator draw at each point of a space-filling design, fits a heteroscedastic regression model of the decision-dependent distribution and reuses the standardised residual vectors as scenarios to construct a deterministic surrogate. ACRS searches this surrogate for several local optima, adds draws around the most promising ones, ranks the candidates on the simulator with common random numbers and finishes with sample-path local refinement using tail importance sampling. translated_title: 决策依赖不确定性下谱风险优化的自适应条件残差抽样
translated_abstract: 我们考虑最小化谱风险目标函数，即期望成本加上加权条件风险价值（CVaR），其中不确定参数的分布依赖于决策，且只能通过随机模拟器在固定的抽样预算下进行抽样。我们提出自适应条件残差抽样（ACRS）方法。该方法在空间填充设计的每个点上抽取一次模拟样本，拟合决策依赖分布的异方差回归模型，并将标准化残差向量作为情景复用，从而构建一个确定性代理模型。ACRS在该代理模型上搜索若干局部最优解，在最有希望的候选点周围增加抽样，利用共同随机数在模拟器上对候选方案进行排序，最后采用尾部重要性抽样进行样本路径的局部精细化。我们证明代理模型最优解的最优性间隙受情景分布的Wasserstein误差约束……
tldr: 提出自适应条件残差抽样（ACRS）方法，通过复用标准化残差向量构建确定性代理模型，高效求解决策依赖不确定性下的谱风险优化问题，并提供基于Wasserstein误差的最优性保证。
en_tdlr: We propose Adaptive Conditional Residual Sampling (ACRS), which reuses standardized residual vectors to construct a deterministic surrogate for efficiently solving spectral risk optimisation under decision-dependent uncertainty, with an optimality gap bounded by the Wasserstein error of the scenario distribution.
